definitions.explanation: The highest point of a mountain or hill.
A meeting between heads of state or other top leaders.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}に{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: I reached the summit of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {頂上|ちょうじょう}からの{景色|けしき}は{素晴|すば}らしかった。
examples.english: The view from the top was magnificent.

examples.japanese: {頂上|ちょうじょう}を{目指|めざ}して{登|のぼ}り{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I kept climbing, aiming for the summit.

examples.japanese: {頂上|ちょうじょう}{会談|かいだん}が{開|ひら}かれた。
{両国|りょうこく}の{首脳|しゅのう}が{頂上|ちょうじょう}{会談|かいだん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The leaders of the two countries held a summit meeting.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}{会談|かいだん}で{貿易|ぼうえき}{問題|もんだい}が{話|はな}し{合|あ}われる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: Trade issues are expected to be discussed at next month's summit meeting.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{頂上|ちょうじょう}に{登|のぼ}る/に{着|つ}く (to reach the summit)
・{頂上|ちょうじょう}を{目指|めざ}す (to aim for the top)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{頂上|ちょうじょう}{会談|かいだん} (summit meeting, summit talks)
・{頂上|ちょうじょう}{決戦|けっせん} (final showdown, championship match)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{頂上|ちょうじょう}: Summit, peak (of a mountain)
・{山頂|さんちょう}: Mountain top (more literary/formal)
・{頂点|ちょうてん}: Apex, peak (often figurative - peak of career, etc.)
